title: Before Eating
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillāh
translation: In the name of Allah.
translation_ar: أبدأ طعامي باسم الله

title: If Forgot Bismillah
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
transliteration: Bismillāhi awwalahu wa ākhirahu
translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.
translation_ar: باسم الله في أوله وآخره
occasion: If you forgot to say Bismillah at the start
occasion_ar: إذا نسيت التسمية في أول الطعام

title: After Eating
ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā wa jaʿalanā muslimīn
translation: Praise be to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.
translation_ar: الشكر لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وجعلنا من المسلمين

title: After Drinking Milk
ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minhu
translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
translation_ar: اللهم بارك لنا في هذا الشراب وزدنا منه

title: Before Sleeping
ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Bismika Allāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā
translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
translation_ar: باسمك يا الله أنام وأستيقظ

title: Upon Waking
ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhi alladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi an-nushūr
translation: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
translation_ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد نومنا وإليه نُبعث

title: Wearing Clothes
ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ
transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāhi alladhī kasānī hādhā wa razaqanīh
translation: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me.
translation_ar: الحمد لله الذي ألبسني هذا الثوب ورزقني إياه
occasion: Said when putting on new clothes

title: Entering Bathroom
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina al-khubuthi wal-khabā'ith
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
translation_ar: اللهم إني أحتمي بك من الشياطين

title: Leaving Bathroom
ar: غُفْرَانَكَ
transliteration: Ghufrānak
translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
translation_ar: أطلب مغفرتك يا الله

title: Before Wudu
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillāh
translation: In the name of Allah.
translation_ar: باسم الله أبدأ وضوئي

title: After Wudu
ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
transliteration: Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illa-Allāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh
translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
translation_ar: أشهد أن لا معبود بحق إلا الله وأن محمدًا عبده ورسوله

title: Leaving Home
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillāhi tawakkaltu ʿala-Allāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh
translation: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah; there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
translation_ar: باسم الله توكلت على الله ولا قوة إلا بالله

title: Entering Home
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
transliteration: Bismillāhi walajnā, wa bismillāhi kharajnā, wa ʿalā-Allāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā
translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
translation_ar: باسم الله ندخل وباسم الله نخرج وعلى الله ربنا اعتمدنا

title: Morning Remembrance
ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh
translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah; all praise is for Allah.
translation_ar: دخلنا في الصباح والمُلك كله لله والحمد لله

title: Evening Remembrance
ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsā al-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh
translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah; all praise is for Allah.
translation_ar: دخلنا في المساء والمُلك كله لله والحمد لله

title: When Sneezing
ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Alḥamdu lillāh
translation: Praise be to Allah.
translation_ar: الشكر لله
occasion: Said by the one who sneezes

title: Starting a Journey
ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn
translation: Glory be to Him who subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves; surely to our Lord we shall return.
translation_ar: تنزيهًا للذي سخّر لنا المركب وإنا إلى ربنا راجعون
occasion: Said when boarding a vehicle for travel

title: Going Uphill
ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Allāhu Akbar
translation: Allah is the Greatest.
translation_ar: الله هو الأكبر
occasion: Said when ascending a hill while traveling
occasion_ar: تُقال عند صعود المرتفعات في السفر

title: Going Downhill
ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Subḥāna-Allāh
translation: Glory be to Allah.
translation_ar: تنزيهًا لله

title: Returning from Travel
ar: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
transliteration: Ā'ibūna tā'ibūna ʿābidūna li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
translation: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.
translation_ar: راجعون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون
occasion: Said when returning from a journey

title: Stopping at a Place
ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-kalimāti-Allāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
translation_ar: أحتمي بكلمات الله الكاملة من شر ما خلق
occasion: Said when stopping at a place during travel
occasion_ar: تُقال عند النزول في منزل في السفر

title: Farewell to Traveler
ar: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
transliteration: Astawdiʿu-Allāha dīnaka wa amānataka wa khawātīma ʿamalik
translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the conclusions of your deeds.
translation_ar: أُودِع الله دينك وأمانتك وخواتيم عملك
occasion: Said to bid farewell to a traveler

title: Mounting a Vehicle
ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillāhi wal-ḥamdu lillāh
translation: In the name of Allah, and praise belongs to Allah.
translation_ar: باسم الله والحمد لله
occasion_ar: تُقال عند ركوب الدابة أو السيارة

title: When It Rains
ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿan
translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
translation_ar: اللهم اجعله مطرًا نافعًا

title: After the Rain
ar: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
transliteration: Muṭirnā bi-faḍli-Allāhi wa raḥmatih
translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
translation_ar: أُمطرنا بفضل الله ورحمته

title: When the Wind Blows
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā
translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it and seek refuge in You from its evil.
translation_ar: اللهم إني أطلب منك خير هذه الريح وأحتمي بك من شرها

title: Hearing Thunder
ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī yusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu bi-ḥamdihi wal-malā'ikatu min khīfatih
translation: Glory be to Him whom thunder glorifies with praise, and the angels from awe of Him.
translation_ar: تنزيهًا لله الذي يسبّحه الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خشيته

title: During a Storm
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ursilat bih
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil with which it is sent.
translation_ar: اللهم إني أحتمي بك من شر ما أُرسلت به

title: When Seeing Clouds
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا
transliteration: Allāhumma asqinā ghaythan mughīthan
translation: O Allah, give us rain that brings relief.
translation_ar: اللهم اسقنا مطرًا نافعًا

title: Dua of Yunus
ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta, subḥānaka innī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓālimīn
translation: There is no god but You; glory be to You, indeed I was among the wrongdoers.
translation_ar: لا معبود بحق إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين لنفسي

title: Removing Distress
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina al-hammi wal-ḥazan
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief.
translation_ar: اللهم إني أحتمي بك من الهم والحزن
occasion: Said when feeling worried or sad

title: When Things Are Hard
ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlā, wa anta tajʿalu al-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā
translation: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make hardship easy when You will.
translation_ar: اللهم لا يسر إلا ما يسرته وأنت تجعل الصعب سهلًا إذا شئت
occasion: Said when facing a difficult task

title: When Afraid
ar: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Ḥasbunā-Allāhu wa niʿma al-wakīl
translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
translation_ar: يكفينا الله وهو نِعم المعتمَد عليه

title: Powerful Dua of Distress
ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Lā ilāha illa-Allāhu al-ʿAẓīmu al-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illa-Allāhu rabbu al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm
translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing; there is no god but Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne.
translation_ar: لا معبود بحق إلا الله العظيم الحليم رب العرش الكريم
occasion: Said in times of great distress

title: When Sad
ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn
translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.
translation_ar: اللهم أرجو رحمتك فلا تتركني لنفسي لحظة

title: For Parents
ar: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbi arḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā
translation: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
translation_ar: ربي ارحم والديّ كما ربياني صغيرًا

title: For Righteous Children
ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka samīʿu ad-duʿā'
translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring; indeed You are the Hearer of supplication.
translation_ar: ربي ارزقني من عندك ذرية صالحة إنك سامع الدعاء
occasion: Said when asking for righteous offspring

title: For Family Unity
ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyun, wa ijʿalnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā
translation: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders of the righteous.
translation_ar: ربنا ارزقنا من أزواجنا وذرياتنا ما تَقَرّ به أعيننا واجعلنا قدوة للصالحين

title: Protecting Children
ar: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
transliteration: Uʿīdhukumā bi-kalimāti-Allāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
translation: I seek refuge for you both with the perfect words of Allah from every devil, vermin, and evil eye.
translation_ar: أحفظكم بكلمات الله الكاملة من كل شيطان وحيوان مؤذٍ وكل عين تصيبكم بسوء
occasion: Said by parents to protect their children

title: Forgive Parents
ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
transliteration: Rabbanā ighfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmu al-ḥisāb
translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day of Judgement.
translation_ar: ربنا اغفر لي ولوالديّ وللمؤمنين يوم الحساب

title: For More Knowledge
ar: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā
translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation_ar: ربي زدني علمًا نافعًا
occasion_ar: تُقال قبل المذاكرة أو أثناء طلب العلم

title: For Understanding
ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliteration: Rabbi-shraḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī wa-aḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī
translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease my task for me, and untie the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech.
translation_ar: ربي اشرح لي صدري ويسر أمري وحُلَّ عقدة من لساني ليفهموا كلامي
occasion: Said before speaking, exams, or presentations
occasion_ar: تُقال قبل الكلام أو الاختبار أو العرض

title: For Useful Knowledge
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan ṭayyiban wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
translation_ar: اللهم أطلب منك علمًا نافعًا ورزقًا حلالًا وعملًا متقبلًا

title: Before an Exam
ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlā
translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy.
translation_ar: اللهم لا يسر إلا ما يسرته أنت

title: For Strong Memory
ar: اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مَا نُسِّيتُ وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا جَهِلْتُ
transliteration: Allāhumma dhakkirnī mā nussītu wa ʿallimnī mā jahiltu
translation: O Allah, remind me of what I have forgotten and teach me what I do not know.
translation_ar: اللهم ذكّرني بما نسيت وعلّمني ما جهلت
occasion: Said when wanting to remember knowledge

title: Entering the Mosque
ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: Allāhumma iftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik
translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
translation_ar: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك

title: Leaving the Mosque
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik
translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
translation_ar: اللهم إني أطلب من فضلك

title: Hearing the Adhan
ar: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
transliteration: Wa anā ash-hadu an lā ilāha illa-Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh
translation: And I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
translation_ar: وأنا أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأن محمدًا عبده ورسوله

title: After the Adhan
ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ
transliteration: Allāhumma rabba hādhihi ad-daʿwati at-tāmmah waṣ-ṣalāti al-qā'imah, āti Muḥammadan al-wasīlata wal-faḍīlah
translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and the virtue.
translation_ar: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة الكاملة والصلاة القائمة أعطِ محمدًا الوسيلة والفضيلة

title: Walking to Mosque
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا
transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿal fī qalbī nūran wa fī lisānī nūrā
translation: O Allah, place light in my heart and light on my tongue.
translation_ar: اللهم اجعل في قلبي نورًا وفي لساني نورًا
occasion: Said when walking to the mosque

title: Understanding the Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا
transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī mā ʿallamtanā
translation: O Allah, bless what You have taught us.
translation_ar: اللهم بارك لنا فيما علمتنا

title: Quran in the Heart
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي
transliteration: Allāhumma-jʿali al-Qur'āna rabīʿa qalbī wa nūra ṣadrī
translation: O Allah, make the Quran the spring of my heart and the light of my chest.
translation_ar: اللهم اجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي ونور صدري
occasion: Said asking for love of the Quran

title: Guidance from Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مِنْهُ مَا نُسِّيتُ وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْتُ
transliteration: Allāhumma dhakkirnī minhu mā nussītu wa ʿallimnī minhu mā jahiltu
translation: O Allah, remind me of what I have forgotten of it and teach me what I do not know of it.
translation_ar: اللهم ذكّرني من القرآن ما نسيت وعلّمني منه ما جهلت

title: Beginning to Recite
ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
transliteration: Aʿūdhu billāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan.
translation_ar: أحتمي بالله من الشيطان المطرود

title: After Reciting
ar: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: Ṣadaqa-Allāhu al-ʿAẓīm
translation: Allah the Most Great has spoken the truth.
translation_ar: صدق الله العظيم

title: Asking Forgiveness
ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا
transliteration: Rabbanā ighfir lanā dhunūbanā
translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins.
translation_ar: ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا
occasion: Said as a general dua for forgiveness

title: Master of Forgiveness
ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ
transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduka
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You, You created me and I am Your servant.
translation_ar: اللهم أنت ربي لا معبود بحق سواك خلقتني وأنا عبدك
occasion: Said as the chief supplication for forgiveness
occasion_ar: تُقال طلبًا للمغفرة في كل وقت

title: Dua of Adam
ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā, wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina al-khāsirīn
translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
translation_ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

title: Short Forgiveness
ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
transliteration: Astaghfiru-Allāha wa atūbu ilayh
translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.
translation_ar: أطلب مغفرة الله وأرجع إليه تائبًا
occasion_ar: تُقال في كل وقت من اليوم

title: Goodness in Both Worlds
ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāba an-nār
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation_ar: ربنا أعطنا في الدنيا خيرًا وفي الآخرة خيرًا وقِنا عذاب النار
